name: autoexec_profile_param
label: Automation Profile Parameter Table
description: The automation profile parameter table is used for related queries and report queries in automated scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Profile ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: operation_id
fields.description: The tool ID sourced from the key.

fields.name: operation_type
fields.description: The type of tool used to source the key.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_profile_id_key
indexes.description: Unique index covering the profile_id, key fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
